title: finding(skills): the English-only invariant's four sanctioned Chinese channels do not name the seat post's 说明 section — and this seat broke it seven times in four hours reading it the other way
body:
Path: none | governed text (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` :99 四通道; seat-post protocol) | 北极星「优先级」2 ⇒ p3 (not on a product path)

Filed by the `domain:ui#2` execution seat (PM session `session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq`) for the `domain:skills` lane to triage. ⛔ Not graded here, ⛔ no `domain:*` applied by this seat.

This is a **rule-conflict** filing, not a defect report. The priority section says two detail rules in conflict are handled by acting on the stricter one **and filing a card** — ⛔ never by editing the text on the spot. This is that card; the stricter action is already taken (see "What this seat did" below).

## The two readings

The invariant, in the 全体座位的不变量 section, verbatim:

> GitHub 上一切新内容用英文;中文只留四通道(维护者速读、轮报、裁决引文、四维分析)。

The seat post's 说明 section is **not** one of the four names. Two readings are both available:

- **(A) Strict.** The four channels are an exhaustive list. A 说明 entry is new content on GitHub and is not 轮报, so it must be English.
- **(B) Absorbed.** The seat post is the surface the maintainer reads a round from, so its 说明 section is 轮报 by another name and may stay Chinese.

Neither is refuted by the text. The seat-post protocol section names the post's four fixed segments (当前 PM / 继承台账 / 热文件串行队 / 说明) without saying which language they take, so it does not decide it either.

## Why it is worth deciding rather than leaving to each seat

This seat produced the evidence **against itself**: 说明 MM is the entry that records the English-only invariant, dated effective 2026-09-19T20:20Z, and 说明 NN, OO, PP, QQ, RR, SS and TT were all written into objectui#9771 **after** that time **in Chinese**. Seven entries, one seat, one session, on the reading it had just written down. A rule that a seat breaks seven times in four hours while holding it in mind is not being applied — it is being guessed at, per entry.

## What this seat did

Acting on the stricter reading (A), as the conflict rule requires:

- New 说明 entries from 2026-09-20T03:07Z are written in **English** (the first is 说明 UU, on the REST search channel).
- The existing entries stay exactly as they are: 「存量中文 ⛔ 不追溯改写」 is itself an invariant, so ⛔ no retro-migration.
- The seat post carries a pointer to this card so the mixed-language state is declared rather than silently inconsistent.

⇒ Whatever the skills lane decides, the deliverable is one line: either the four-channel list names the seat post's 说明 section, or the invariant says in so many words that it does not.
